references.text: Parallel description of the dimensions of the courtyard hangings on the west side of the tabernacle, with fifty cubits of curtain, ten pillars, and ten bases.
The original instruction from God to Moses regarding the construction of the courtyard hangings, including the measurements and materials used.
The full context for the construction of the courtyard, where the west side is described as part of the entire enclosure around the tabernacle.
Description of the south and north sides of the courtyard, showing the same pattern with pillars, bases, hooks, and silver crossbars.
Summary that the hooks and crossbars of the pillars were made of silver, and that the tops of the pillars were overlaid with silver.
This reference confirms that the actual execution of the north wall in 38:12 fully corresponds to the original instructions in 27:11.
This verse establishes the general rule for all the pillars that 38:12 follows specifically on the west side.
